 Tony Fairbairn Tennis November 10, 2026 
 By Tony Fairbairn
 Toby Samuel [Q] def Leo Borg [WC] 6-3 6-2
 Samuel v Lorenzo Musetti [3] | H2H: First Meeting
 STOCKHOLM, SWEDEN – Toby Samuel cruised past Leo Borg in Stockholm and will now face Lorenzo Musetti.

 H2H & Match Fundamentals
 Toby Samuel [Q] v Lorenzo Musetti [3] H2H: First Meeting 
 ATP Stockholm 2026 Stockholm, Sweden 
 Indoor Hard Prize Money: €12,695 
 Fourth on Center Court (18:30 GMT) Sky/Now TV <- Subscription Required 
 It was a comfortable victory for Toby Samuel over Swedish wildcard Leo Borg and the Brit will now face third seed Lorenzo Musetti . 
 Tale of the Tape – Key Stats (Last 52 Weeks)
 Embed from Getty Images 
 H2H: Toby Samuel (WR 97) Lorenzo Musetti (WR 25) 
 Tournament Previous Best N/A  N/A 
 1 st Serve % 64.4 64.8 
 Service Games Won % 79.3 82.8 
 Break Points Saved % 65.7 65.4 
 2 nd Serve Return Points Won % 56.7 52.1 
 Break Points Converted % 48.7 38.1 
 Samuel will hope to continue his returning efficiency against one of the most effective servers on the tour.
 Playing styles and prediction
 Musetti has had a great end to the season despite injuries derailing his progression. The Italian has played some flawless tennis and is now aiming to have a deep run in Stockholm. Another big week at an ATP 250 event could see the Italian reach the world’s top 20.
 Samuel will need a high first serve percentage and will look to dictate play on the forehand side. Meanwhile, Musetti will be aggressive on the backhand side and look to open up the angles on the court. This will be a great test for Samuel but Musetti may just have too much firepower for the British qualifier.
 Prediction: Musetti in three sets.
